page.layout: One column of running text, with line numbers (5, 10, 15 ... 35) in the right margin. A title in the text at the top of the page's middle. Running head at the top; page number at top left. No footnotes, no catchword beyond the hyphenated word at the foot.

main_text.p: 314. Iohannes Hircanus, Simonis F, Matthathiæ nepos, propter indolem præstantem dux paterni exercitus creatur, & Cendebæum Antiochi præfectum fugat, aliaque præclarè ac fortiter gerit. Clarus fuit tribus maximis rebus, principatu gentis, dignitate sacerdotis, & spiritu pro-5phetiæ.
main_text.head: XI. Profopographia gentium ecclesiæ adversantium ex historiâ V. T. est eiusmodi.
main_text.p: 315. Gigantes, fuerunt multitudo ferox, nomine celebri & magnâ potentiâ ob corporis proceritatem, nata in10 perniciem ecclesiæ, inimica disciplinæ, propriâ virtute nitens, & ideo de terrâ tandem à Deo sublata.

316. Sodomæi, solum terrarum optimum colentes, nacti sunt doctorem Lothum. Ipsorum urbs omnis turpitudinis officina, scelerumque asylum evasit. Quâ de causâ cū15 tribus vicinis urbibus de cœlo funditus consumitur sulphure & igne, quintâ propter Lothum servatâ.

317. Sichemitæ, homines leves, malè tractantur à filiis Iacobi propter stupratam à Sichemo, regis filio, sororem20 ipsorum germanam. Execratur vir sapiens in suis concio-nibus, Samaritanos, Philistinos, & Sichemitas, designans hypocritas, tyrannos, & levem multitudinem.

318. Chananæi, generatim sic dicti, possederunt regionem cis & ultra Iordanem amplam & valde fertilem, ibique compararunt illustre imperium, & divitias ingentes. Sed25 donis Dei petulanter & perditè abusi, afflixerunt sanctos viros, qui inter eos vixerunt hospites & advenæ. Quare scelerum ipsorum mensurâ quasi completâ, extirpati sunt à Deo isti populi, Amorrhæi, Pherefæi, Chananæi, specia-30tim ita dicti, Hethæi, Gergesæi, Euæi, Iebusæi: eorumque regna & possessiones iuxta promissum & mandatum Dei, in Israëlitas, Semi & Abrahami posteros, dividuntur: & terram impiorum tandem semen iustorum hæreditatem accipit. In hac terrâ Christus est natus ex virgine.35

page.notes: Running head and page number read as printed. The title "Profopographia" is printed that way (should be Prosopographia); left as printed. The hyphenated breaks "concio-nibus", "pro-phetiæ", "specia-tim" and "info-" are taken as printed hyphens. "info-" at the foot is the catchword for the next page. Margin numbers 5 to 35 are line numbers and are given as notes. The stray marks at the far right edge belong to the neighbouring page and are left out.
